label: UniFi Express (UX) AX3000 cloud gateway
description: Ubiquiti UniFi Express (UX) - Wi-Fi 6 AX3000 dual-band cloud gateway with a built-in 2x2 access point (2.4 GHz 574 Mbps, 5 GHz 2.4 Gbps) and exactly two wired ports: one 1G WAN and one 1G LAN. It is managed through UniFi Network rather than a local CLI, and the single LAN port means any switch hangs off that one link.
